rows.Synonyms:
• Champagne Moment
• KORvanaber
• Lion's Fairy Tale
rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: KORvanaber
Exhibition name: Lions-Rose ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, before 1999).
Introduced in Canada by Palatine Fruit & Roses in 2007 as 'Lion's Fairy Tale'.
Introduced in United States by Ashdown Roses Historic Archive in 2007 as 'Lions-Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, cream shading, apricot center. Mild, sweet fragrance. Average diameter 3.25". Full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, compact, upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' (60cm). Width: 20" (50cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Very vigorous. Disease susceptibility: very blackspot resistant., mildew resistant.
